messages:
zara_partnerships: Quick sync / AstraGrid agreed to co-host a 40m hybrid session + 20m hands-on afterparty at CloudCon on Jul 22. Need to lock speakers, demo routing (on-prem vs Redwood Private), and swag distribution (enamel pins + stickers).
tom_hw: We'll demo live on an AstraGrid rack showing multipod orchestration + 8-bit quant performance. Studio wants Redwood to provide a fallback endpoint.
nina_pm: Partner prefers we run the failover from Redwood Dedicated. Can we prepare a canary route and a visible switch in the demo so audience sees failover?
omar_eng: Yes. I'll prep a dedicated pool and add a /ready health endpoint. Example call: curl -I https://demo.redwood.ai/status returns 200 OK. Will tag requests with X-Session: astracloud.
leah_ops: Shipping notes: AstraGrid will accept swag drop at their booth. Redwood to ship 300 pins + 500 stickers to SF warehouse by Jul 8, and 50 backup kits to Redwood office. Need customs for EMEA shipments.
rachel_marketing: For co-branded creative: please send AstraGrid logo and approved lockups. Also want a landing page with UTM params and a partner promo code.
marco_astrag: Sending logos now. AstraGrid can provide PROMO: ASTRA30 for attendee trial credits. We'll also supply a 2-min partner intro video.
tom_hw: Demo run-of-show draft:
1) 4m intros
2) 8m joint product positioning
3) 10m live demo (Astra rack -> Redwood fallback)
4) 10m hands-on lab sign-up walkthrough
5) 8m panel Q&A + CTA
Keep demo to three scripted prompts and one deliberate failover.
nina_pm: Speaker list: Nina (Redwood host), Tom (hw demo), Marco (Astra lead), Felipe (customer cameo). Marco confirm Felipe available?
marco_astrag: Felipe confirmed for cameo. He'll share a short case note.
omar_eng: SSH/proxy note for studio NAT: use demo proxy at proxy.redwood.ai on port 8443; I will create short-lived credentials and share with studio ops.
leah_ops: Timeline: swag addresses to logistics@redwood by Jun 25, creative by Jun 18, rehearsal week of Jul 15. Who owns fulfillment?
arz: (typo)
zara_partnerships: Redwood owns fulfillment but AstraGrid handles local pickup at booth. Leah please coordinate customs paperwork.
calendar-bot: Rehearsal scheduled / Jul 18 10:00 PDT, duration 90m. Invitees: zara_partnerships, tom_hw, nina_pm, omar_eng, marco_astrag, felipe_customer.
rachel_marketing: I'll draft landing page copy and the post-event email sequence (3 emails). Need promo code confirmation and LP fields.
marco_astrag: Promo code ASTRA30 confirmed. Also can provide 30-sec soundbite for intro.
zara_partnerships: Final action items: 1) Healthcheck + proxy creds by Jul 1 (omar), 2) Swag addresses by Jun 25 (leah), 3) Creative + logos by Jun 18 (marco + rachel), 4) Speaker slides by Jul 8 (all). Anything else?
tom_hw: One ask  add an alarm if p95 latency jumps >200ms during rehearsal and post event.
omar_eng: Will route alerts to #eng-oncall and #partnerships.
zara_partnerships: Thanks everyone 680. I'll follow up with AstraGrid PR timeline and speaker bios.
